mapper.select:
select b.id as historyId, b.goods_id as goodsId, g.title, g.cover, g.price, g.old_price as oldPrice, g.quality, g.location, g.status, b.browse_count as browseCount, b.last_browse_time as browseTime from browsehistory b left join goods g on b.goods_id = g.id where b.user_id = #{userId} order by b.last_browse_time desc, b.id desc
limit #{limit}
